title: Included Screening and Address Services, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Service Feature Matrix — Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs

Four address and screening services are fixed per pack size of the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs. For each pack the matrix states whether the service is included.

| Pack | Skip tracing of undeliverable first letters | Free resubmission with a corrected address | Bankruptcy screening | Deceased screening |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | Not included | Included | Not included | Not included |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | Not included | Included | Not included | Not included |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | Included | Included | Not included | Not included |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | Included | Included | Included | Included |

## What each service means

- **Skip tracing.** Where included, a debtor whose first letter is returned undeliverable is skip-traced and re-mailed without a new unit.
- **Free resubmission with a corrected address.** Where included, resubmitting the same debtor with a corrected address within the undeliverable window uses no new unit.
- **Bankruptcy screening.** Where included, submissions are screened for bankruptcy and matched debtors earn a unit credit.
- **Deceased screening.** Where included, submissions are screened for deceased debtors and matched debtors earn a unit credit.

## Points of judgement

| Question about a pack | First Notice 50-Unit and 150-Unit Programs | First Notice 300-Unit Program | First Notice 600-Unit, 1200-Unit and 2500-Unit Programs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Is a debtor with an undeliverable first letter skip-traced and re-mailed without a new unit? | No | Yes | Yes |
| Does resubmitting the same debtor with a corrected address within the undeliverable window use a new unit? | No | No | No |
| Are submissions screened for bankruptcy and deceased debtors? | No | No | Yes, for both |
